text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The winner is Hishi Amazon!
Showing off the sheer presence expected of a champion!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Dammit, I couldn't reach in time...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Hishi Amazon!
Though wasn't Biko Pegasus coming off
a minor injury this time?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, but they still hung in there with all their might.
They did splendidly! A real little hero!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Yeah...
I lost, but I gave it everything I had...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Justice Biko's battle continues...!
Everyone! I'll win next time for sure,
so make sure to watch again!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan... You may have lost, but you showed more than enough guts to prove that small can still stand tall...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
So cool... Yeah!
I can't let myself be discouraged either!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Great work, Biko. That was a great race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Hishi Ama...! Congratulations...
Ugh, it stings, but congratulations! For real!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch.
We managed to get our payback for back then, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Still, if I let my guard down, they'll catch up in an instant. That's how it felt...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Neither you nor I are done yet—
we're gonna get way, way stronger! Right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Of course!
Strength is the true mark of a hero, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll use this defeat as a springboard to push even further!
Catch ya later, Sis Hishi Ama!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelming victory for Narita Brian!!
She has conquered the Satsuki Shoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
So it's this Umamusume this year after all.
With such bottomless potential, her future is something to look forward to!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Brian achieved a complete and expected victory
in the Satsuki Sho.
That race generated massive excitement as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the heat of the race had settled down,
I reviewed the performance together with Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how was my race
the other day?
choice_data_list: Yeah, your speed has improved dramatically.
Yeah, your speed has improved dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Speed... Right, for a sprinter, it's the most essential quality of all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If we keep getting faster and faster at this rate,
then by autumnâ

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"We might be able to infiltrate.
Into the hideout where the big boss is...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even if we dive in, we might not stand a chance
at all. But still! Even so!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I showed everyone
that I can run side-by-side with Big Sis Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I want to race an even more amazing senior!
To prove that I've gotten stronger as a hero!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So my next target is—the Big Boss!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final boss... There is only one race
where the horse girl bearing that title is certain to run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A race over the distance best suited to the big boss
of the sprint division, Sakura Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Namely, the autumn 1200m GⅠ—
choice_data_list: You want to run in the "Sprinters Stakes", don't you?
You want to run in the "Sprinters Stakes", right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! And there, I wanna—
shine brighter and run faster than anyone else!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Even if I get beaten to a pulp, just like Carrotman, I'll turn it into strength for next time! So!"
choice_data_list: Got it! Let's head to the Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Really, Trainer!? Yaay!
Alright, let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It may be too early for this challenge. However,
without striving for ultimate speed, true strength cannot be spoken of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To demonstrate speed that could rival even the older generation,
Biko Pegasus set her sights on the Sprinters Stakes.
